item.title: KSB shares rally 7% after securing Rs 118 crore export order for boiler feed pumps
item.description: KSB shares gained 7% after the company secured a $12.4-million export order from Dangote Projects Free Zone Enterprise for 18 boiler feed pump packages.

item.title: Molbio Diagnostics shares rally 9% as Jefferies initiates 'high conviction top pick' call for recently listed stock. Why is it bullish?
item.description: Molbio Diagnostics shares jumped after Jefferies initiated coverage with a Buy rating and named it a high-conviction top pick. The brokerage set a Rs 1,600 target price, implying 27% upside from Tuesday’s close and nearly 98% above its Rs 807 IPO price. The stock had listed at a 21% premium at Rs 980.

item.title: Morgan Stanley raises Lenskart target price to Rs 718; bull case implies 41% upside. Here’s why
item.description: Lenskart Solutions reported a 182.3% YoY rise in Q1 FY27 net profit to Rs 228 crore, while revenue grew 33.6% to Rs 2,214 crore. EBITDA margin improved to 21.7%, with growth across domestic and international markets. The company also reported strong demand for both affordable and premium eyewear, highlighting the scaling potential of its international business.

item.title: BSE enters Nifty 50: Stock drops 4% after Goldman Sachs, BNP Paribas sell shares worth Rs 2,186 crore
item.description: On their debut in the Nifty 50 index, BSE shares saw a significant decline of about 4%. This drop was influenced by Goldman Sachs and BNP Paribas offloading more than 68 lakh shares. In a bid to stabilize the situation, UTI Mutual Fund and Nippon India Mutual Fund collectively bought roughly 52.43 lakh shares.
